Graduation

Graduation forms: MS students (CDE / Design)

Forms for the Green Light meeting and the master’s thesis defense.

When & how
When
In the semester you plan to graduate: Green Light in Weeks 5–9, defense in Weeks 15–16.
How
  • Week 5: submit the Green Light committee nomination (3 members including your supervisor; 1 external member optional).
  • By Friday 23:59 of Week 8 (7 days before the Green Light): email your thesis draft, 80% complete with at least 5,000 words in English, with Turnitin and AI-check results. A late draft disqualifies you for that semester.
  • Weeks 8–9: present at the Green Light meeting. Send the draft to your committee at least one week before.
  • Week 9: email the completed Green Light meeting evaluation form.
  • Week 15: request graduation and nominate your committee in UNIST Portal → Graduation, then print the form and get committee signatures.
  • Week 16: after the defense, submit the thesis approval and evaluation forms signed by all committee members.
Submit to
Academic & Student Affairs staff, Department of Design office (by email for the draft and the Green Light evaluation)
  • All forms ↓
  • Thesis evaluation ↓
  • MGP / Thesis approval ↓

Qualifying Exam (Q.E.) application

Apply for the Q.E., required for PhD and MS-PhD combined students.

When & how
When
By May 1 for the June Q.E., or by November 1 for the December Q.E. The exam is in Week 15.
How
  • Requirements: at least 12 course credits in your area and a GPA of 3.5 or higher.
  • Set up a committee of 3 with your supervisor as main member (1 external member optional).
  • Get the application form from the staff in charge at the Department office.
  • Submit the form with your Q.E. slides: an in-depth literature review or a research project presentation.
Submit to
Academic & Student Affairs staff, Department of Design office

Graduation forms: PhD students

Forms for the pre-defense and the doctoral dissertation defense (PhD and MS-PhD combined).

When & how
When
Pre-defense: apply in Week 9, exam in Weeks 15–16, at least 3 months before graduation. Defense: Weeks 15–16 of the semester you plan to graduate.
How
  • Before the pre-defense: finish your course credits, pass the Q.E., keep a GPA of 3.0 or higher, and get your supervisor’s permission and research proposal approval.
  • Week 9: submit the pre-defense application with 5 committee members (supervisor as chair, 1 external evaluator, 3 or more UNIST professors).
  • Week 15: request graduation and nominate your committee in UNIST Portal → Graduation → Thesis/Dissertation Info, then print the form and get committee signatures.
  • Week 16: after the defense, submit the dissertation approval and evaluation forms signed by all committee members, with your Turnitin result.
Submit to
Academic & Student Affairs staff, Department of Design office
